name: uptime-kuma
one_liner: A free, self-hosted tool that watches your websites and services and tells you instantly, by text or chat message, the moment one goes down.
buyer: An IT consultant or freelancer managing uptime for a dozen small-business clients who wants a free self-hosted alternative to Pingdom or UptimeRobot.
business_use_cases: An IT consultant monitors uptime for a dozen small-business clients from one dashboard and bills a monthly 'website watchdog' retainer.
An e-commerce store owner self-hosts it to get a Slack or SMS alert the moment their storefront goes down, before it costs them sales.
A web agency embeds a public status page built on it into every client site it maintains, as a value-add it can charge for.

money_ideas.idea: A managed hosting / status-page-as-a-service plan for non-technical small-business owners who don't want to self-host
A 'website watchdog' monitoring retainer service for local businesses, built on this free tool

steal_this: Spin up a hosted instance this weekend, monitor twenty local small-business websites, and sell a $15/month 'we'll text you the second your site goes down' service.
